topic: Canada–Cohere and Anthropic new-credit coordinate evidence

facts.claim: ISED reports one signed Cohere contribution agreement, $240 million supporting a $725 million project.
facts.population: ISED including special operating agencies; Q-935 response
facts.evidenceType: primary parliamentary government response recovered through browser
facts.locator: ISED response (a)/(c), second agreement table row, 20-03-2025
facts.coordinateUse: Corroborates historical project denominator and signed status, not October equity stages.
facts.limits: Row uses announcement date March 20, whereas proactive disclosure starts March 10; do not silently equate them. Duration and file number are reported not applicable here, not evidence that no agreement term exists.

facts.claim: Agreement 820219 is a partially conditionally repayable contribution, not equity.
facts.population: ISED–Cohere Inc., SIF Stream 2 Growth, agreement 820219
facts.locator: Agreement Value; Agreement Type; Additional Information; Agreement Date
facts.coordinateUse: Context only: distinct instrument from October 2026 equity.
facts.limits: Face value is not disbursed cash, remaining availability, or safety-conditioned money. Long agreement term need not be construction or payment period.

facts.claim: ISED describes a $725 million project supported by up to $240 million; Cohere is anchor tenant for CoreWeave's Cambridge facility.
facts.coordinateUse: Matched denominator for announced contribution/project share only.
facts.limits: Not audited eligible costs, company valuation, investment round, or protected-model activity.

facts.claim: The contribution ceiling equals 33.10% of the stated prior project cost.
facts.locator: Project statement first paragraph; disclosure Agreement Value
facts.coordinateUse: Usable contextual financial-intensity ratio, not y safety coverage.
facts.limits: Ceiling/project comparison; does not establish all dollars paid, eligible, discretionary, or safety-controlled.

facts.claim: Canada announces up to $1.6 billion equity, staged with progress reporting.
facts.locator: PM opening commitment and staging paragraph; company round paragraph identifying government equity
facts.coordinateUse: Candidate financial scope; no known negotiable denominator.
facts.limits: Not a signed subscription, paid amount, or discretionary balance; distinct from agreement 820219.

facts.claim: Cohere reports an initial close of a round targeting up to CAD 7 billion.
facts.coordinateUse: Contextual target; cannot denominator-match uncommitted public equity.
facts.limits: Initial-close amount is undisclosed; target is not cash raised. Do not add government ceiling as though outside this round.

facts.claim: Cohere undertakes at least $1.7 billion additional Canadian compute infrastructure by 2030.

facts.coordinateUse: Future physical-spending context only.
facts.limits: Not another government investment, existing capacity, tranche amount, or independently reconciled project expenditure.

facts.claim: Cohere undertakes at least 1000 new Canadian technical jobs by 2030.
facts.coordinateUse: Concrete non-safety milestone available for future performance checks.
facts.limits: No evidence of an executed draw condition, jobs delivered, or safety metric.

facts.input: covenant-covered negotiable capital / all negotiable capital in same stage
facts.claim: No matched executed covenant numerator and still-negotiable stage denominator were retrieved.

gaps.field: contribution 820219 disbursements, eligible-cost schedules, repayability triggers
gaps.reason: Q-935 ISED body is now recovered: signed status and 240/725 amounts corroborated, but no payment ledger, eligible-cost annex or repayment formula. Administrative amendment-date placeholder remains unusable.
gaps.nextRetrieval: Obtain the agreement/payment annex or matching public-accounts transaction; Q-935 need not be re-retrieved for its ISED response.

ISED itself does not claim secrecy for its contribution row.

gaps.field: exact-safeguard consent and pre-Geneva stage deadline

gaps.field: future safeguard operation and safety effect

facts.claim: No revolver cash borrowings at December 31, 2025.

facts.claim: No revolver cash borrowings at June 30, 2026.

facts.claim: Standby LCs outstanding were $78 million at June 30, 2026.

facts.claim: Commitments less disclosed cash borrowings and outstanding LCs equal $3.172 billion.

facts.claim: Aggregate revolving commitments on the closing date were $15 billion.
facts.population: Anthropic September 2026 amended and restated revolver
facts.evidenceType: primary filed executed-form agreement, tool-extracted text
facts.locator: Section 1.01, Revolving Facility Commitment definition, sentence beginning The aggregate amount
facts.coordinateUse: Corrects prior repository claim that total facility size was absent. Known committed pool, not new negotiable capital.
facts.limits: Does not reveal individual allocations, cutoff utilization or an uncommitted safety-controllable amount.

facts.claim: The LC sublimit is $15 billion and explicitly part of, not additional to, the revolver.
facts.coordinateUse: Avoid double counting; not a second financing pool.
facts.limits: Sublimit does not establish issued LCs or available capacity.

facts.claim: Required Lenders hold strictly more than 50% of the specified loan/commitment denominator, excluding defaulting lenders.
facts.unit: strict lower threshold fraction, not inclusive
facts.population: outstanding Incremental Term Loans plus revolving commitments; exposure replaces commitments if terminated
facts.coordinateUse: Known voting rule, not coalition holding, consent share, or x coordinate.
facts.limits: Borrower agreement also required; affected-lender and agent exceptions apply. No allocation vector or safety votes retrieved.

facts.claim: The base limb uses the greater of $7.5 billion and 50% of consolidated total assets.
facts.coordinateUse: Potential capacity formula only.
facts.limits: Not remaining headroom, bank commitment, or cash availability; needs utilization and financial statements.

facts.claim: A further capacity limb uses 65% of qualifying equity cash receipts, capped at $20 billion, with anti-double-use qualifications.
facts.population: qualifying equity cash receipts on or after 2025-01-01
facts.coordinateUse: Formula parameter only; do not multiply fundraising headlines without qualifying receipts.
facts.limits: Excluded prior uses and actual receipt amounts require verification. Not equity funding plus separate cash of the same amount.

facts.claim: Contribution Incremental Amount is capped at $20 billion.
facts.population: clause (y) only, not whole incremental formula
facts.coordinateUse: Contextual cap, not promised new credit.
facts.limits: Additional leverage-based limbs exist; this is neither total maximum debt nor actual unused capacity.

facts.claim: 478 calendar days separate the referenced original closing and this restatement.
facts.locator: Recitals, Original Closing Date; agreement heading/Closing Date
facts.coordinateUse: Historical interval, not negotiation duration or probability of pre-Geneva completion.
facts.limits: No negotiation-start date; no claim that this is a safety amendment precedent.

facts.claim: Annual financials are due within 160 days of year-end, beginning with 2026.
facts.coordinateUse: Existing evidence-delivery cadence, not safety evaluation cadence.
facts.limits: Nonfinancial proprietary information is carved out; report delivery is not public access or a safety test.

facts.claim: The calendar calculation gives June 9, 2027, twelve days before Geneva's June 21 start.
facts.population: annual financial reporting checkpoint versus user-specified Geneva date
facts.evidenceType: calendar arithmetic; future deadline, not observed delivery
facts.coordinateUse: Planning constraint only; no assumed ability to negotiate or test in twelve days.
facts.limits: Future delivery unobserved; no inference that annual financial statements contain safety evidence.

facts.claim: Initial revolver stated maturity is the fifth anniversary of September 4, 2026.
facts.locator: Section 1.01 Maturity Date and Closing Date
facts.coordinateUse: No maturity-driven refinancing deadline before Geneva.
facts.limits: Springing maturity and business-day qualifications exist; voluntary earlier transactions remain possible.
